column1: # Anchored citations: file <TAB> line <TAB> regex that line must match <TAB> which doc claims it
# R2 only proves a cited line exists. These prove it still says what the doc says it says.
# Add a row whenever a core doc pins a claim to a specific line.
# Patterns are POSIX ERE, evaluated with `grep -qE`, so ( ) | . * need escaping to be literal.
